thread:
Sam: quick async — what I did / blockers / today
Sam: Did: landed a kernel slot-prefetch tweak on canary, ran a 1k-seq microbench. 95p latency improved ~6-8%.
Sam: Blocker: intermittent OOMs on node-gpu-12 when burst batch_size spikes; logs show kv cache churn + eviction thrash.
Sam: Today: triage OOM, add lightweight eviction counters to telemetry, coordinate with Liam on batcher heuristics.

Liam: sweet. can you paste the bench numbers when you have them?
Liam: On my side: pushed a fairness tweak to the batcher that reduces HOL for small sequences. PR 1247 up; no throughput regressions locally.
Liam: Also added metric slots_in_use to help spot leaks.

Maria: re: OOMs — I suspect long-lived chat sessions growing kv entries. rolled a TTL for idle kv entries in staging (30m) just now. will watch.
Maria: If that doesn't cut it we should consider evict-by-token_count instead of entry_count.

Nisha: FYI perf harness shows 95p down 220ms -> 205ms after Sam's change. saw a slight p50 bump for long sequences, investigating.

Elaine: grabbed logs from node-gpu-12, snippets below:
```text
[2026-03-16T22:14:03Z] mem: 89% used, kv_cache_entries: 2.3M, eviction_cycles: 142
[2026-03-16T22:14:03Z] OOM: alloc failed for kv_bucket 0x7f...
```
Elaine: tagging oncall + deploy-bot — @deploy-bot any recent kernel/module autorolls on that node?

deploy-bot: kernel-module v0.9.3 auto-rolled to node-gpu-12 at 2026-03-16T21:50Z (canary policy). no config diffs reported.

Sam: plan: revert autoroll on node-gpu-12, run targeted microbench and mem-profiling, add eviction counters to telemetry, and file a short RFC for eviction policy.

Liam: ack. I'll pause merging PR 1247 until memory profile is stable.

Maria: if needed I can shorten TTL to 10m for faster turnover while we debug.

Nisha: assigning myself to run the perf harness against long-seq workloads and generate flamegraphs; ETA EOD.

Elaine: small request — when folks approve perf-related PRs, please paste a one-line perf snippet in the review. that speeds root-cause during incidents :thumbsup:

Sam: created issue 8821 with logs + plan: https://redwood.internal/issue/8821

Liam: thanks — will review once mem profile is in.

Maria: monitoring staging TTL roll, will report back in ~30m.

Nisha: will post harness results here when done.

Sam: +1 thanks everyone, will update issue and follow up in this thread.
